subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin memorySearch.extraPaths ingest arbitrary JSONL raw logs, or should raw JSONL recall stay outside the builtin Markdown/multimodal memory path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but widening builtin ingestion changes sensitive memory visibility and may conflict with lean-core/plugin-boundary guidance unless maintainers sponsor the core behavior.

options.title: Document Supported Alternative
options.body: Keep builtin extraPaths Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.

options.title: Add Native Builtin JSONL
options.body: Implement JSONL as a first-class builtin memory format with line-aware parsing, watcher and memory_get support, tests, docs, and privacy guardrails.

options.title: Design Plugin/API First
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers decide whether a plugin or memory API extension should own arbitrary raw-log ingestion.

recommendation.title: Document Supported Alternative
recommendation.body: Keep builtin extraPaths Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided maintainer-side context on this issue and has the strongest inspected memory host/runtime history.
